candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from payment authorization calls timing out (~2s ReadTimeout), propagating through order to gateway; payment POST /v1/authorizations eventually returns 200 after ~3s, exceeding the caller's timeout.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side metrics/traces excluded from context; exact payment latency distribution unconfirmed. Order deployment record alone does not establish cause.

report.explanation: Traces show payment POST /v1/authorizations ReadTimeout (~2s) causing order and gateway 502s; inventory/redis succeed. Gateway and order p95 ~2406ms with 502s. Bounded candidate is downstream payment latency; payment-side telemetry is missing to fully substantiate.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and traces to confirm payment-side slowness as the timeout source
Order service traces (excluded) to confirm the timeout originates at the payment dependency call
